commission: TRY FOREVER heartbeat 1600: strict byte-first persisted identity without crossing the P0/phone firewall.
head: feat/heartbeat-skill-lights-20260815
trigger: Code-first review of the existing ingress owner showed OperatorState.updateHeartbeatLights uses String.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8). That encoder replaces malformed UTF-16 input rather than reporting it. A byte-first downstream verifier cannot recover evidence that was already normalized away before persistence.

selectedJudgmentJars.why: Repair must stay in the existing ingress owner and pure source/test surfaces; no phone/P0/runtime deployment work.
Semantic safety says malformed Unicode must fail closed rather than be normalized into canonical telemetry.
A source repair is not deployed runtime behavior and must remain below TESTED/DEPLOYED/CALLABLE.
The newly discovered upstream normalization path is a reachable failure path that invalidates the first plan's completeness assumption.

antagonism: Do not pretend projectBytes alone closes the encoding wound if OperatorState has already replaced malformed UTF-16 before Base64 persistence.
Do not add a second persistence owner or semantic parser in the receiver; preserve opaque ingress architecture.
Do not convert this source repair into phone execution, deployment, or P0 coordination.
Do not change valid payload bytes: strict encoding of well-formed Unicode must remain byte-for-byte equal to StandardCharsets.UTF_8 for ordinary input.
Do not silently swallow the invalid payload as success; preserve prior stored heartbeat by failing before SharedPreferences mutation.
revisedPlan: Front A2 — Existing ingress owner: change OperatorState.updateHeartbeatLights to encode heartbeat JSON with a strict UTF-8 CharsetEncoder configured to REPORT malformed/unmappable input before any SharedPreferences mutation. Keep the same byte ceiling, Base64, SHA, timestamp, and atomic commit contract.

Front B2 — Regression source: add a package-visible pure helper on OperatorState only if needed for deterministic unit coverage; prove well-formed astral Unicode encodes identically and unpaired surrogate input is rejected before persistence. Do not introduce another controller or codec owner.

Front C2 — Byte-first downstream projection remains as implemented: exact persisted bytes are cloned, byte/SHA checked, then strict-decoded before parser trust. Together the two seams make normalization failure explicit on both sides of persistence.

Front D2 — Update warm-wall semantics only if needed after review; otherwise preserve the existing new UTF-8 encoding scar. Persist Regnet/Venice/swarm receipts with the discovered assumption and repair.
acceptance: Malformed UTF-16 heartbeat JSON cannot be silently replacement-encoded into persisted canonical bytes by OperatorState source.
Well-formed Unicode retains exact UTF-8 bytes and existing Base64/SHA persistence semantics.
No new persistence/controller/runtime owner is created and no phone/P0 surface is touched.
Source/readback and regression source do not promote TESTED or later capability states.
